topic_rationales.T10102: The quantitative study of science itself — citation analysis, research evaluation, indicators, mapping of fields. The historical core of metaresearch.
topic_rationales.T13607: The scholarly publishing system: open access, APCs, journal and publisher policies, predatory publishing, preprints.
topic_rationales.T13516: Scholarly communication practices — peer review, authorship, dissemination, the social organisation of publishing.
topic_rationales.T11492: Research integrity, misconduct, retractions, plagiarism. Known false-positive class: student/classroom academic integrity (cheating, contract cheating) — flag for review.
topic_rationales.T13976: Altmetrics and web-based indicators of research visibility and use.
topic_rationales.T11937: Research data management, data sharing, FAIR principles, data repositories, and data citation. Unanimously added by team codesign (Phase 1 validation, Sep 2026) to capture landmark Canadian open data and open science scholarship.
